examples.text: gaṇato te aṭṭhavidhā bhū'v'ādigaṇo rudh'ādigaṇo div'ādigaṇo sv'ādigaṇo kiy'ādigaṇo gah'ādigaṇo tan'ādigaṇo cur'ādigaṇo cā'ti.

65487.meaning1: completely committed; fully determined (to); intently resolved (on)

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu bālo abyatto akhettaññū akusalo… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, so taṃ nimittaṃ na āsevati na bhāveti na bahulīkaroti na svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.

65488.meaning1: correctly heard; well transmitted by tradition

examples.text: api ca, bhāradvāja, svānussutaṃ'y'eva hoti, tañ'ca hoti rittaṃ tucchaṃ musā, no ce'pi svānussutaṃ hoti, tañ'ca hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anaññathā.
acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho! ayaṃ samaṇo nisinnako'va kālaṅ'kato, sv'āyaṃ paṭisañjīvito'ti. iminā kho evaṃ, pāpima, pariyāyena āyasmato sañjīvassa sañjīvo't'eva samaññā udapādi.
sv'āyaṃ, brāhmaṇa, puggalo n'ev'attan'tapo n'āttaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto na paran'tapo na paraparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto.

65493.meaning1: good to approach; good to encounter

examples.text: tass'eva kho pana pubbe aviddasuno abhijjhā hoti chando sārāgo. sv'āssa pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tāl'āvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
so micchāvācāya pahānāya vāyamati, sammāvācāya upasampadāya, sv'āssa hoti sammāvāyāmo.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro bahuno janassa piyo ahosi manāpo. svāssudaṃ aṅken'eva aṅkaṃ parihariyati
atha kho bhagavā tassa aḍḍhamāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi, yena sv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, vihārena paṭham'ābhisambuddho viharāmi, tassa padesena vihāsiṃ.
sv'āhaṃ abbūḷhasallo'smi, sītibhūto'smi nibbuto, na socāmi na rodāmi, vata sutvāna māṇavāti.
ajj'eva me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatu sve vā uttarasve vā'ti
